# Science & Plants for Schools (SAPS)

> > A comprehensive resource hub providing practical teaching materials and laboratory activities for plant biology education across primary and secondary schools.

SAPS offers curriculum-aligned teaching resources for biology educators, featuring hands-on practicals using common plants like Tradescantia, onions, and pondweed to teach microscopy, photosynthesis, cell division, and plant disease. Resources span from primary school investigations to A-level set practicals, with contributions from educators like Dr Chris Graham and Vicki Cottrell.

## Key Topics

- Plant biology education
- Microscopy techniques
- Photosynthesis practicals
- Cell structure and mitosis
- Stomata and transpiration
- GCSE and A-level biology
- Laboratory practicals
- Plant disease investigation
- Primary school science
- Tradescantia zebrina
- Brassica rapa (Fast Plants)
- Secondary education resources
- Plant cells and tissues
- School garden investigations
- Biological molecules

## Laboratory Practicals and Techniques

- [Teaching Microscopy Using Plants](https://www.saps.org.uk/growth-hub/teaching-microscopy-using-plants): Guide to teaching microscopy skills using plant specimens like Tradescantia
- [A-level set practicals - using a potometer](https://www.saps.org.uk/teaching-resources/resources/1341/a-level-set-practicals-using-a-potometer): A-level practical for measuring transpiration using potometer (OCR/AQA/Edexcel)
- [Using Green Cabomba Pondweed in the Lab](https://www.saps.org.uk/teaching-resources/resources/749/using-green-cabomba-pondweed-in-the-lab): Lab guide for using Cabomba to demonstrate photosynthesis oxygen evolution
- [Using Spinach in the Lab](https://www.saps.org.uk/teaching-resources/resources/743/using-spinach-in-the-lab): Lab guide for photosynthesis and chromatography practicals using spinach
- [Using Garlic in the Lab](https://www.saps.org.uk/teaching-resources/resources/752/using-garlic-in-the-lab): Lab guide for using garlic root tips to study mitosis and cell cycle
- [Using Onions in the Lab](https://www.saps.org.uk/teaching-resources/resources/757/using-onions-in-the-lab): Lab guide for onion cell structure, stomata, and DNA extraction practicals
- [Measuring Stomatal Density](https://www.saps.org.uk/teaching-resources/resources/299/measuring-stomatal-density): Techniques for measuring stomatal density in leaf epidermis investigations

## Cell Biology and Microscopy

- [Microscopy - Amazing African Violets](https://www.saps.org.uk/teaching-resources/resources/784/microscopy-amazing-african-violets): Practical activity using African Violets to study specialized plant cells
- [Video clip - Chloroplasts and starch](https://www.saps.org.uk/teaching-resources/resources/795/video-clip-chloroplasts-and-starch): BBC video introducing chloroplasts and starch accumulation discovery
- [Pollen and other Airborne Particles](https://www.saps.org.uk/teaching-resources/resources/137/pollen-and-other-airborne-particles): Method for studying atmospheric pollen and hay fever allergens

## Plant Disease and Pathology

- [Plant disease practicals - powdery mildew](https://www.saps.org.uk/teaching-resources/resources/1360/plant-disease-practicals-powdery-mildew): GCSE citizen science practical for powdery mildew survey and data analysis
- [Plant pathogens: control (poster and presentation)](https://www.saps.org.uk/teaching-resources/resources/1413/plant-pathogens-control-poster-and-presentation): GCSE poster on plant pathogen control methods from polyculture to imports

## Plant Structure and Anatomy

- [The Structure of Flowers](https://www.saps.org.uk/teaching-resources/resources/547/the-structure-of-flowers): Diagram of flower anatomy and structure for secondary biology education

## Primary School Activities

- [Gardening for Primary Schools - suggestions for investigations](https://www.saps.org.uk/teaching-resources/resources/233/gardening-for-primary-schools-suggestions-for-investigations): Curriculum-linked school garden investigations for primary students
- [How tall are you in leaves?](https://www.saps.org.uk/teaching-resources/resources/152/how-tall-are-you-in-leaves): Cross-curricular primary activity on non-standard measurement using leaves

## Research and Educational Articles

- [Fast plants for finer science - an article from the Journal of Biological Education](https://www.saps.org.uk/teaching-resources/resources/282/fast-plants-for-finer-science-an-article-from-the-journal-of-biological-education): Article on rapid-cycling Brassica for plant breeding and genetics teaching

## Optional

- [Cell division Archives](https://www.saps.org.uk/resource-topic/cell-division): Archive of cell division and mitosis teaching resources
- [Biological molecules Archives](https://www.saps.org.uk/resource-topic/biological-molecules): Archive of biochemistry resources covering caffeine, chlorophyll, and starch
- [Classification Archives](https://www.saps.org.uk/resource-topic/classification): Archive of plant classification and identification resources for primary
- [Missing Page](https://www.saps.org.uk/missing-page): 404 error page for missing or unavailable content
